style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Hanging Toadstools & Acorns with Twig Tree
style.toneOfVoice: Bring a whimsical woodland charm to your autumn décor with this striking artificial black twig tree, complete with a mixed bag of hanging woodland toadstools and acorns. This delightful set features a variety of miniature hanging decorations, including intricately detailed toadstools and realistic acorns, perfect for adding texture and character to your seasonal displays. Ideal for decorating Christmas trees, garlands, wreaths, or even as part of a rustic table centrepiece, each piece is designed to evoke the enchanting feel of a forest in fall. Lightweight and easy to hang, they offer endless styling possibilities for a cosy, woodland-inspired look. • 2x Large Toadstool H9xD8cm • 4x Medium Toadstools H7xD5.5cm • 4x Small Toadstools H5.5xD4.5cm • 11 Pinecones & 6 acorns
